APIT is the most suitable localization approach in terms of accuracy and communication overhead for irregular radio patterns and random node placement; and that localization accuracy has a significant impact on the performance of location dependent applications.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the choice of localization algorithm is application-dependent and that the impact of localization error on applications is application-specific.

APIT performs best when a large number of nodes are deployed and the radio pattern is irregular, while the impact of localization inaccuracy on the application performance depends on the specific application and the degree of location awareness required.

the accuracy of localization has a significant impact on the performance of location dependent applications, and the impact is application dependent.
